definitions.explanation: Describes a person who has a large physical frame or stature.
Describes fabric, clothing, or designs with large, bold patterns.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大柄|おおがら}な⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧だ。
{大柄|おおがら}な⟦{体格|たいかく}→体格：16207_taikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{生|い}かしてラグビー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: He took advantage of his large build and started playing rugby.

examples.japanese: ⟦{兄|あに}→兄：00570_ani⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧{大柄|おおがら}で、{百八十|ひゃくはちじゅう}⟦センチ→センチ：01372_senchi⟧⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: My older brother has the largest build in the family, standing over 180 centimeters tall.

examples.japanese: {大柄|おおがら}な⟦{花柄|はながら}→花柄：26238_hanagara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ワンピース→ワンピース：04526_wanpiisu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a dress with a bold floral pattern.

examples.japanese: {大柄|おおがら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦チェック→チェック：03000_chekku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{目立|めだ}つ→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧。

⟦{小柄|こがら}→小柄：12362_kogara⟧な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{大柄|おおがら}な⟦{柄|がら}→柄：02609_gara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{柄|がら}→柄：02609_gara⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{負|ま}けて→負ける：01134_makeru⟧しまうこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: When a small-framed person wears clothing with bold patterns, the pattern can overpower them.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 (large build) is the more common meaning. Often used as a neutral or positive descriptor, without the negative nuance of "fat" or "overweight."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大柄|おおがら}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a large-framed person)
- {大柄|おおがら}な⟦{体格|たいかく}→体格：16207_taikaku⟧ (a large build)
- {大柄|おおがら}な⟦{柄|がら}→柄：02609_gara⟧ (a bold pattern)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{小柄|こがら}→小柄：12362_kogara⟧: small-framed, petite — the opposite
- ⟦{細身|ほそみ}→細身：20336_hosomi⟧: slender, slim — describes body shape rather than frame size
